fusions.name: Lashing Plait
fusions.desc: Swings a braid at a target up to 5 tiles away. It deals 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at maximum range, and the target moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Spun Into Thread
fusions.desc: Whirls a mane of strands around you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning each one for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Strung Across
fusions.desc: Spins a wall of strands 5 tiles long ahead of you that blocks enemies for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Spindle Whip
fusions.desc: Conjures a whip spun from your hair. It increases your weapon damage by 12% and your attack speed by 6%, and every strike with it leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 2 seconds.
